reason: The monoclinic cell and a Pr/Te/Br-ordered NdSBr-like average framework are supported, but exact recovery is not established. No comparable whole-pattern score was supplied, and the claimed approximately 8.1% residual comes from an ad hoc unweighted profile model; an independent reconstruction remains about 8.6% (about 7.3% only after adding an unreported intensity-decay term), with systematic intensity residuals above the pattern noise. More importantly, the sole Z=4 P21/c model has a low density of 3.77 g/cm^3 and very long Pr-Br contacts, while the trajectory's scientifically motivated Z=8/six-site possibility was not brought to a chemically valid, comparably refined whole-pattern candidate and alternative monoclinic symmetries were not instantiated. The six simple element permutations distinguish the ordering only within the assumed three-site framework and do not resolve Z, symmetry, coordinates, or possible site splitting. Another solution attempt is therefore warranted.
